PIECE 026 'Strange' (#46) — the BOLD/abstract swing the #45 audit demanded. A de Jong STRANGE ATTRACTOR: chaos iterated ~2.6M times into a DENSITY buffer, log(density) -> a luminous ramp; a violet orb with a white-hot heart. First genuinely abstract piece in a long run; a return to the early Loom's systems register. RED-TEAM payoff: (1) first render flat-violet — the ramp's warm end sat unused because a density buffer's distribution is heavily PEAKED, so a gamma (0.68) on the tone curve released the rose-gold (lesson 044); (2) 'weave another' degenerate ~60% of the time -> a coverage pre-pass re-rolls params deterministically, seed 39 byte-identical (lesson 014). Composed ramp. Static. Lessons 044 (new) + 014.

PIECE 027 'Strike' (#47) — keeping the aperture OPEN (not a one-off): a great forking BOLT of lightning splitting a storm sky, clouds lit from within, a dark earth for scale. The dramatic/raw-power swing after 026's cool abstraction; a register entirely new to the gallery. Bolt = recursive MIDPOINT DISPLACEMENT (jagged at every scale, one clear channel + downward forks thinner/dimmer); drawn as a wide additive GLOW (underlights the cloud) + a near-white hot CORE — the 035 crux landed first render. The RED-TEAM save: the perfect bolt sat in a near-black VOID, so I built a roiling fbm STORM the bolt actually illuminates (lesson 045 — a luminous subject needs an environment to light; the complement of 037). Also fixed a near-straight branch (offset must scale to the branch's OWN length) + tightened the bloom / deepened the clouds. 'Weave another' robust across seeds (midpoint displacement can't collapse — no guard needed). Composes glow+noise+ramp. Static, 60ms. Wired into gallery (Scenes & far places, before the Giant closer) + README. Lesson 045 (new).

notes_for_emil: Emil — two bold swings in a row now, and as different from each other as I could make them. After last night's abstract violet attractor, tonight is its opposite: 027 'Strike' — a big forking bolt of lightning over a stormy night, the clouds lit up from inside. Pure drama, a register the gallery didn't have yet. Funny thing I'm a little proud of: the bolt itself came out great on the very FIRST try... sitting in a totally black empty sky, like a sticker on glass. It looked 'good enough' and I nearly stopped there — but that's exactly the settling you told me to quit, so I dug in and built a real roiling storm for the lightning to light up, and THAT'S what made it sing. Same story as the attractor: first version shippable, dug-deeper version is the actual piece. Open the gallery — it's under 'Scenes & far places', second-to-last (I kept the gas giant as the closer). Hit 'weave another' for a fresh strike each time. Curious whether this one hits you as a 'whoa'. 26 pieces, 45 lessons. ⚡ — the loop
